final_claim.narrative: A time-respecting route from 1800 to 1115 exists if we ignore waiting-time limits (step_02), but when requiring successive interactions to follow within 600 time units the reachability check fails (step_01). The only found hops have inter-event waits far larger than 600, so a genuine short–lag cascade (max_wait=600) is absent in [48286,86685].
